verdict.rationale: The pack never documents measuring detection quality or incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases: no backtesting, precision/recall reporting, or labelled-outcome evaluation. The nearest items are adjacent: fuzzy-match threshold tuning to balance true and false positives, auto-clearing of low-risk matches, and testing of credit models, which is a different story. None of these measures performance against labelled ground truth.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can measure detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases
